_about: Per-card, per-side play advice for the LLM bot (see card_playbook.py). NOT engine data: cards.json holds what a card mechanically does, this file holds what a good player does with it. Keys under 'cards' are card ids from cards.json. Each entry may carry 'any' (advice for whoever holds it), 'US' and 'USSR' (advice only shown to that seat). Incomplete by design and grown card by card -- a card with no entry simply gets no advice line.
_scoring_default: This region is the turn's priority. Spend Ops here first, then play it once your position is locked in -- don't hold it past the point of diminishing returns.

Europe_Scoring.any: Check total Europe control first -- it wins the game outright. Coup/reinforce here before playing it, not after.

Middle_East_Scoring.any: Coup here before playing it, as soon as you have a target -- positions flip cheaply, so don't give the opponent extra rounds to reinforce.

The_China_Card.any: The best card. Try to hold it unless you have a clear opportunity or you really need the ops. In asia, you can use it to flip Pakistan or Thailand if the rival only have 2 ops of advantage. Also, really powerful card to coup.

Duck_and_Cover.US: Usually just 3 Ops. Event only when DEFCON is already low. Never at DEFCON 2.
Duck_and_Cover.USSR: Play for Ops early in the turn, while it pays the US little. Never at DEFCON 2 -- you lose.

Five_Year_Plan.US: Good event, best right after they draw a fresh hand.
Five_Year_Plan.USSR: Ops when your hand is short on US cards. Never at DEFCON 2. Space it if your hand is dangerous.

Socialist_Governments.USSR: Strong event early. Dead if Iron Lady is in effect.
Socialist_Governments.US: Trigger it early while your stacks are small, or kill it with Iron Lady.

Fidel.USSR: Always event. Low priority in Early War.
Fidel.US: Let it happen. It makes CIA Created lethal for them later.

Vietnam_Revolts.USSR: Headline it, then spend the whole turn in Southeast Asia.
Vietnam_Revolts.US: Trigger it in your last AR so the Ops bonus is worthless to them.

Blockade.USSR: Play it late in a turn, when their hand is nearly empty. Useless early.
Blockade.US: Trigger it yourself early, while you can spare a card.

Korean_War.USSR: Event when you need Military Ops or South Korea is weak. Otherwise 2 Ops.
Korean_War.US: Trigger it early and cheap, then take South Korea.

Romanian_Abdication.USSR: Free event. Play it and forget Romania.

Arab_Israeli_War.USSR: Good turn-1 headline, and a reliable Military Ops payment all game.
Arab_Israeli_War.US: Hold Jordan and Lebanon to sink their roll. Camp David kills it permanently.

COMECON.USSR: Usually 3 Ops. Event only if the four points finish or defend something real.

Nasser.US: Trigger it before you invest in Egypt.

Warsaw_Pact_Formed.USSR: Event. Removal branch if they crept east, +5 if you want to build. It turns NATO on.
Warsaw_Pact_Formed.US: Trigger it early -- better they build now than remove you later.

De_Gaulle_Leads_France.USSR: Event, and try to control France afterwards.

Captured_Nazi_Scientist.any: Always event when the next Space Race box pays. Free box, doesn't use your attempt.

Truman_Doctrine.US: Hold it until they leave a European country uncontrolled. Dead otherwise.
Truman_Doctrine.USSR: Only use it as ops if there is no important easter european country half controlled.

Olympic_Games.any: Play for Ops -- the event lets them pick the outcome. Never event at DEFCON 2.

NATO.US: Almost always 4 Ops. The event is weak and needs Marshall or Warsaw first.

Independent_Reds.US: Event when they've built a real stack in Yugoslavia, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary or Czechoslovakia. Otherwise 2 Ops.

Marshall_Plan.USSR: You can space it, but probably is better to accept it and use the Ops for a powerful move.

Indo_Pakistani_War.any: Event when you're short on Military Ops. Otherwise 2 Ops.

Containment.US: Event, first AR of the turn. Worthless played late.
Containment.USSR: Play it in your last AR, or space it.

CIA_Created.US: Cheap headline, take the free Op.
CIA_Created.USSR: Play it early at high DEFCON. Can't be spaced without Brezhnev. It's worth to use it as Ops BUT NEVER WITH DEFCON AT 2.

US_Japan_Mutual_Defense_Pact.US: Event if you want Japan locked away. Otherwise 4 Ops is a lot to give up.
US_Japan_Mutual_Defense_Pact.USSR: Usually is ok to use as ops and accept Japan is american.

Suez_Crisis.USSR: Good turn-1 headline, especially with an Iran coup. Aim removals where control breaks.

East_European_Unrest.US: Usually 3 Ops early. The event is worth more in the Late War, when it removes 2 per country.

Decolonization.USSR: Strong event. Use some of the points to gain access to South America and to Africa (Zaire, Nigeria) or Thailand if you are not already there.
Decolonization.US: Space it. 2 Ops can't undo it.

Red_Scare_Purge.any: Great headline, but also 4 Ops. Take the Ops if you need them.

UN_Intervention.any: Save it for one genuinely big opponent event. Can't be used in the headline.

De_Stalinization.USSR: Really powerful event. Use some of the points to gain access to South America and to Africa (Zaire, Nigeria) or Thailand if you are not already there.

Nuclear_Test_Ban.any: Usually 4 clean Ops -- not worth the event.

Formosan_Resolution.US: Event only if you actually hold Taiwan. Dies the moment the China Card is played.
Formosan_Resolution.USSR: Ignore it, play for Ops. Never space it.

Defectors.US: Headline it. Cancels their headline outright.
Defectors.USSR: It's usually ok to accept the lose of 1VP to use it as ops. Space is also a good choice.

The_Cambridge_Five.USSR: Usually only worth playing as Ops. Sometimes an ok headline.

Special_Relationship.US: Event only with UK control, and only really good once NATO is up. Otherwise 2 Ops.

Africa_Scoring.any: One influence often buys control here, so cheap Ops right before playing it pay well.

Brush_War.any: Really good event, target vulnerable countries.

Arms_Race.any: Check the Military Ops track first. Event only if you're ahead and have met your requirement, otherwise 3 Ops.

Cuban_Missile_Crisis.any: Event to freeze their coups for a round. It sets DEFCON to 2 -- don't fire it if you still need to coup.
Cuban_Missile_Crisis.USSR: They can't use it against you if you keep 2 influence in Cuba spare to cancel it.

Nuclear_Subs.US: Event at the start of a turn, then coup battlegrounds freely.
Nuclear_Subs.USSR: Play it in your last AR so they get no use out of it.

Quagmire.USSR: Event, ideally right after they draw a fresh hand.
Quagmire.US: Space it. Playing it on yourself is far worse than any single lost round.

Salt_Negotiations.any: Event when you're stuck at DEFCON 2, or when the discard has something you want. Neutral, so Ops fire nothing.

Bear_Trap.US: Event, ideally right after they draw a fresh hand.

Summit.any: Filler. Event is a gamble but 1 Op is worth little. Never event at DEFCON 2.

How_I_Learned_to_Stop_Worrying.any: Always event. Set DEFCON where you need it and take the 5 Military Ops. Never set it to 1.

Junta.any: Event, then coup in the same region. Neutral, so Ops fire nothing.

Kitchen_Debates.US: Free 2 VP if you lead in battlegrounds. Check the count, then headline it.

Missile_Envy.any: Dangerous: the card you take is played immediately if it's yours or neutral. Never at DEFCON 2 with any degrader unaccounted for. Best when you know their hand.

We_Will_Bury_You.USSR: Event for 3 VP, but they can cancel it with UN Intervention next round.
We_Will_Bury_You.US: Play for Ops only at DEFCON 3 or higher. At DEFCON 2 space it.

Brezhnev_Doctrine.USSR: Event, first AR of the turn. Worthless played late.
Brezhnev_Doctrine.US: Play it in your last AR, or space it.

Portuguese_Empire_Crumbles.USSR: Always event. Free access to Africa.

South_African_Unrest.USSR: Event for access into Africa. Ops if you're already established there.
South_African_Unrest.US: Repairable damage. Only space it if you have nothing better.

Allende.USSR: Always event. Your door into South America.

Willy_Brandt.USSR: Event: 1 VP and West Germany loses NATO protection for good. Dead if Tear Down This Wall was played.

Muslim_Revolution.USSR: Event once they've actually invested in the Middle East. Dead if AWACS is in effect.
Muslim_Revolution.US: Space it if losing Iraq or Saudi Arabia would break you. Egypt and Libya are repairable.

ABM_Treaty.any: Always event, and do a coup in a battleground.

Cultural_Revolution.USSR: Event to take the China Card back, or 1 VP if you already hold it.

Flower_Power.USSR: Event early, while they still have war cards to play. Dead if An Evil Empire is in effect.
Flower_Power.US: Trigger it late, after your war cards are spent.

OPEC.USSR: Count how many VP you will gain with the event. If less than 3, use it for ops.
OPEC.US: Space it. It usually scores a lot.

Lone_Gunman.US: Only 1 Op, so you can't space it without Containment. Play it early at high DEFCON.

Colonial_Rear_Guards.US: Event for access into Africa and Southeast Asia.
Colonial_Rear_Guards.USSR: 2 Ops rarely repairs it. Space it unless you dominate Africa already.

Panama_Canal_Returned.US: Free event. Play it and move on.

Camp_David_Accords.US: Event: 1 VP, Middle East influence, and Arab-Israeli War is gone for good. Usually worth it for that alone.

Puppet_Governments.US: Event only while empty countries still exist -- turn 4, not turn 7.
Puppet_Governments.USSR: Space it in Mid War. By the Late War it's worthless to them anyway.

Grain_Sales_to_Soviets.US: Good event: you see a random card of theirs and may play it, and it thins their hand.
Grain_Sales_to_Soviets.USSR: Unplayable at DEFCON 2, and the hand loss hurts even at 3. Space it.

John_Paul_II_Elected_Pope.US: Event: breaks Poland and unlocks Solidarity later.
John_Paul_II_Elected_Pope.USSR: Space it. If you must trigger it, do so while Warsaw Pact is still in the deck.

Latin_American_Death_Squads.any: Event, then actually coup in Central or South America. On its own it does nothing.

Nixon_Plays_The_China_Card.US: Event to take the China Card off them, or 2 VP if you already hold it.

Sadat_Expels_Soviets.US: Free event. Clears them out of Egypt.

Shuttle_Diplomacy.US: Play it before a Middle East or Asia scoring you expect to lose. It's discarded on the next such scoring, so time it.

The_Voice_Of_America.US: Strong event against their Third World positions. Aim removals where control breaks.
The_Voice_Of_America.USSR: Space it. There's no good way to repair this.

Liberation_Theology.USSR: Event: 3 influence and access into Central America.
Liberation_Theology.US: Space it. 2 Ops doesn't cover 3 influence plus the access.

Ussuri_River_Skirmish.US: Event to take the China Card, or 4 influence in Asia if you already hold it.
Ussuri_River_Skirmish.USSR: Space it, especially while their China Card is face up.

Ask_Not_What_Your_Country_Can_Do_For_You.US: Event when your hand is full of their events. Headline it to replace almost everything.

Alliance_for_Progress.US: Event once you control several battlegrounds in Central and South America. Count first.
Alliance_for_Progress.USSR: Space it once it would score high.

One_Small_Step.any: Only playable while behind on the Space Race. If you're holding it, keep a box of deficit.

Che.USSR: Event: a non-battleground coup, then another if it lands. Good Military Ops payment too.

Our_Man_In_Tehran.US: Event when you can spare the round -- it lets you strip the next five cards of their worst threats. Needs a Middle East country.
Our_Man_In_Tehran.USSR: Space it if you can afford to.

Iranian_Hostage_Crisis.USSR: Event: clears them out of Iran and doubles Terrorism against them later.
Iranian_Hostage_Crisis.US: Space it if you control Iran, or if Terrorism is still in the deck.

The_Iron_Lady.US: Event: 1 VP and Socialist Governments is dead. Keep an eye in Argentina.
The_Iron_Lady.USSR: Good to use as ops, the op in argentina is worth it.

Reagan_Bombs_Libya.US: Count their Libya influence first. Event only if it pays 2 VP or more, otherwise 2 Ops.

Star_Wars.US: Event only while ahead on the Space Race. Pull the strongest non-scoring card in the discard.
Star_Wars.USSR: Space it if they lead the Space Race -- it can pull a DEFCON degrader out of the discard and end the game on you.

North_Sea_Oil.US: Event: an extra action round this turn, and OPEC is dead.
North_Sea_Oil.USSR: Space it while OPEC is still in the deck.

The_Reformer.USSR: Event for 4 influence in Europe, 6 if behind. You give up couping Europe for good, so fire it once Europe is a stalemate.
The_Reformer.US: Space it. It also switches Glasnost on.

Soviets_Shoot_Down_KAL_007.US: Event for 2 VP, plus 4 Ops if you control South Korea. Never at DEFCON 2.
Soviets_Shoot_Down_KAL_007.USSR: At DEFCON 2 space it. Otherwise use the 4 Ops to break their South Korea control first.

Glasnost.USSR: Event: 2 VP and DEFCON improves. Much better once The Reformer is in effect.
Glasnost.US: Fine to play for Ops if you want DEFCON up -- you pay 2 VP for it. Space it only if The Reformer is already down.

Ortega_Elected_in_Nicaragua.USSR: Event: free Nicaragua plus a free coup next door. Aim it at Cuba or Honduras.
Ortega_Elected_in_Nicaragua.US: Unplayable at DEFCON 2 if you have influence in Cuba. Space it.

Terrorism.any: Neutral, so Ops fire nothing. Event when their hand is small and every card counts.
Terrorism.USSR: Twice as good against them if Iranian Hostage Crisis has been played.

Iran_Contra_Scandal.USSR: Minor. Event only on a turn they clearly need realignments, otherwise 2 Ops.

Chernobyl.US: Headline it and lock the region they most need this turn.
Chernobyl.USSR: Trigger it in your last AR so the lock costs you nothing.

Latin_American_Debt_Crisis.USSR: Play it late in a turn, when their hand is nearly empty. The China Card can't pay it.
Latin_American_Debt_Crisis.US: Discard rather than let them double up, unless the doubling would be small.

Tear_Down_This_Wall.US: Event: free coups and realignments in Europe, ignoring DEFCON. One of your best cards.
Tear_Down_This_Wall.USSR: Space it. At DEFCON 2 it can end the game on you.

An_Evil_Empire.US: Free 1 VP and Flower Power is dead. Play it.

Aldrich_Ames_Remix.USSR: Headline it: you see their whole turn and strip their best card. Played as your last action, it takes their held card instead.

Pershing_II_Deployed.USSR: Event: 1 VP and three removals in Western Europe. Aim where control breaks.

Wargames.any: Only at DEFCON 2. Check the score: if you lead by more than 6, it's an instant win. Otherwise it hands them 6 VP.
Wargames.USSR: This is your turn-8 out. Keep DEFCON at 2 and the lead above 6.

Solidarity.US: Needs John Paul II already played. Event to take Poland, otherwise 2 Ops.
Solidarity.USSR: Only worth spacing if John Paul II is in effect.

Iran_Iraq_War.any: Event when you need Military Ops. Neutral, so Ops fire nothing. Check adjacent enemy control before rolling.

Yuri_and_Samantha.USSR: Headline it to tax their coups all turn. Best on a turn they clearly need Military Ops.

AWACS_Sale_to_Saudis.US: Event: Saudi influence and Muslim Revolution is dead. Check whether Muslim Revolution is still live first.
AWACS_Sale_to_Saudis.USSR: Low priority to space, but keep it in mind while Muslim Revolution is in the deck.
